QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_12

question.text: In India, Category III AIFs cater primarily to:

answer.text: HNIs and institutional investors willing to take higher risk

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.1, Cat III AIFs pool capital from HNIs and institutional investors with higher risk appetite. The Trap: Retail/NRI/government-only are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent investor-base profile. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Strict KYC + risk profiling is essential before onboarding Cat III AIF clients.
